text_block_list.text:
"That day, Nice Nature didn't show up when training time arrived.
Usually, she would arrive ahead of time, but..."
Worried, I go look around the academy for her—

—She stood before the tree stump.
A classic spot among the Umamusume
for shouting out bottled-up feelings.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...There's no one here, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Alright...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whyyyyy...
did I say something like that?! I'm such an idiot--!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "Declaring war... against that classic shonen protagonist...?!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Background characters have gotten way too full of themselves!! Seriously, geez... you idiotsss!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're not even sparkling yet...!
Dummy dummy dummy dummy, you huge dummmyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's no use, I don't feel refreshed at all...
choice_data_list: Nice Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wah!?
T-T-T-Trainer-san!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Why here...? Wait, ah!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Is it training time already...?
choice_data_list: Yeah.
Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaahhh~~~... ah?! Hasn't something like this happened before?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Auuugh... Why is it that Trainer always
sees me at my most pathetic...?
choice_data_list: It's all right.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
choice_data_list: You can show your vulnerable side to me, you know.
You can show me your vulnerable side, you know.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh...
Uuuuuuu~~!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna run!
I'm scared...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhh...!

Afterward, Nice Nature continued to cry
with child-like honesty.
And then—

Once she calmed down,
she shared her feelings with me...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm in amazing shape right now.
I think... it might be the best form I've ever been in."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I've gained strength, and I have the confidence for it.
I'm prepared to fight with everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Still... what if we lose?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even if this is the strongest version of me...
what if I'm still nowhere close to sparkling...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I'm terrified.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If I lose here,
it feels like everything I've been so far will be completely rejected.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I haven't gone all out yet." "There's still room to grow."
"This isn't everything I have"...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even though I desperately tried to protect it like that.
I can't... make that kind of excuse anymore.
choice_data_list: You're serious about this, aren't you?
You're serious about this, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...!
That's right, I'm totally serious!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I'm giving this everything I have, so if I lose...
I'll just go right back to being someone who was 'almost good enough.'"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'm scared.
So, so scared...
choice_data_list: Don't worry, you won't lose.
It's okay, you won't lose

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. Right now, even more than usual,
I don't think I can take that at face value."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Because there's no way I can live up to it.
I don't feel like I can take even one more step..."
choice_data_list: Can't I believe in it anyway?
Can't I believe in it anyway?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...!
On what basis could you possibly believe that?
choice_data_list: There's plenty of proof right here.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Could this be...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Is this... an origami trophy?
It looks kinda flimsy, though.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...You really made it for me.
Hehe, I'm still feeling wiped out, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...The 'wobbly trophy.'
Did you prepare one for me today too?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Trainer's trophy...

What I showed Nice Nature were prototypes
of the handmade trophies
I had been giving her all this time.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Kokura Kinen," "Kikuka Sho," "Arima Kinen,"
"Tenno Sho (Autumn)"... and so many others...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "...You made this much... for me...?"
choice_data_list: This is also the result of continuing to believe in you.
This is also the result of continuing to believe in you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"—Everything I've built up
until now..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...You could have given up on me along the way, you know?
Why did you keep believing in me, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: Because I like you.
It's because I like you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Eh, wha, what?
W-What did you just say...!?

"As her Trainer, I told Nice Nature that I was
cheering from the bottom of my heart for her—
for never giving up on victory and giving it her absolute all..."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, I kind of figured that's how it would turn out.
Even though I knew, still...!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Yeah, sorry.
I think I might've panicked a little too much.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I realized that openly declaring
you're going to win is actually terrifying.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Teio was always fighting against this kind of pressure, wasn't she?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's amazing... but.
I won't be intimidated anymore.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Because after all, I've got people
who love me on my side, don't I?"
choice_data_list: And in large numbers!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Folk
text_block_list.text:
Nei-chaaan!
Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature, looking good, looking good!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I had another reason for wanting to win...
a very, very important reason."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...
I can't just keep whining like this anymore.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Man, Trainers have it rough, don't they?
Having to do mental care like this on top of everything."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I suppose that's part of your job, though.
choice_data_list: Because my job is to make you shine
Because my job is to make you shine.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Only because it's your job?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Juuust kidding!
Nope, never mind, it's nothing!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It was training, right?!
I-I'll dash off and change right away!

"...Looks like she's regained her spirits.
Then all that's left is to move forward together!"
